title: Released our first game on Play Store, do check it out
author: CuriousSapien777
selftext: We've been sitting on this project for a while. We started polishing it more after astra and fable launch with feedbacks from our friends and family. Do check it out. Feedbacks are always welcome.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/CuriousSapien777 please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: CuriousSapien777
replies.body: Will do a detailed comment in a moment

comments.author: CuriousSapien777
comments.body:
So we're a two-man team, and both of us are game developers. We've worked at different game development companies, so we rarely get free time to work on our own game.

We've been working on this game for the past six months. After Fable and Astra launched, we realised how good LLMs had become at design too. So we started using them for our designs and stuff.

We've been continuously polishing the game, adding visuals, and refining things based on feedback from friends and family. We've been using Astra, Fable, and Opus5.5 for this.

For development and programming, though, we still use Cursor, with Grok, Composer before that.
